    (attrs : Option (alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))) (es : Slice Entry)
    (hcap : (ctl.acps_search.val.map (·.attrs.length)).sum +
      (ctl.acps_modify.val.map (fun m => m.presattrs.length + m.remattrs.length +
        m.pres_classes.length + m.rem_classes.length)).sum < Usize.max) :
    ∃ y, access.effective_permission_check ctl ident attrs es = ok y := by
  sorry

lean.code:
/-- [kanidm_kernel::access::effective_permission_check]:
    Source: 'ports/kanidm/kernel/src/access.rs', lines 653:0-683:1
    Visibility: public -/
def access.effective_permission_check
  (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (ident : Identity)
  (attrs : Option (alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)))
  (entries : Slice Entry) :
  Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec AccessEffectivePermission)
    OperationError)
  := do
  let search_related_acp ← access.search_related_acp ctl ident attrs
  let modify_related_acp ← access.modify_related_acp ctl ident
  let delete_related_acp ← access.delete_related_acp ctl ident
  let effective_permissions ←
    access.effective_permission_check_loop ident entries search_related_acp
      modify_related_acp delete_related_acp ctl.sync_agreements
      (alloc.vec.Vec.new AccessEffectivePermission) 0#usize
  ok (core.result.Result.Ok effective_permissions)

    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_loop]
def access.effective_permission_check_loop
  (ident : Identity) (entries : Slice Entry)
  (search_related_acp : alloc.vec.Vec profiles.AccessControlSearchResolved)
  (modify_related_acp : alloc.vec.Vec profiles.AccessControlModifyResolved)
  (delete_related_acp : alloc.vec.Vec profiles.AccessControlDeleteResolved)
  (sync_agmts : alloc.vec.Vec SyncAgreement)
  (effective_permissions : alloc.vec.Vec AccessEffectivePermission)
  (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result (alloc.vec.Vec AccessEffectivePermission)
  := do
  loop
    (fun (effective_permissions1, i1) =>
      access.effective_permission_check_loop.body ident entries
      search_related_acp modify_related_acp delete_related_acp sync_agmts
      effective_permissions1 i1)
    (effective_permissions, i)
